mechanism: Uber can monetize demand aggregation, dispatch, payments, safety, advertising and utilization across human-driven and autonomous supply if riders and fleet partners value marketplace distribution more than vertical integration.
catalyst: Trip and booking growth converts to sustained free cash flow; autonomous-fleet partners use Uber distribution at attractive unit economics; insurance and incentives remain controlled; and platform take rate and engagement remain durable.
invalidation: Autonomous fleets bypass Uber or impose uneconomic terms; trip growth stops producing incremental cash; insurance, incentives, regulation, litigation, stock compensation or fleet investments consume the marketplace benefit; or network liquidity deteriorates.
